known_limitations: S04 and S07 titles each leave a single character on their second line inside the timeline block. Measured CJK advance is ~19.78px at fontSize 20, so S04 needs 178px of inner width but its proportional 177px block yields only 159px (175px even with zero padding), and S07 needs 198px against 178px available. Removing the orphan would require widening the block beyond its true 45/50-minute scale, which the task forbids, so the proportional widths were kept. Both titles are fully readable and are repeated as single lines in the index panel.
